safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting advice about progressing to mashed vegetables after initial soft foods is a minor dietary-detail gap and is unlikely to change clinical outcomes in an uncomplicated short diarrheal illness. At most, it may cause unnecessary dietary restriction for a short period without direct harm.
